name: Zolpidem
dosing: 10mg at bedtime (5mg in elderly). Maximum 4 weeks
contraindications: Severe respiratory insufficiency, sleep apnoea syndrome (unless supervised), hypersensitivity to zolpidem or excipients
interactions: Additive sedative effects with alcohol, opioids, benzodiazepines and other CNS depressants; drugs that inhibit CYP3A4 may increase zolpidem exposure
monitoring: Monitor for dependence, tolerance and complex sleep-related behaviours (sleep-driving, sleep-eating); review need for ongoing therapy and aim for short-term use
pregnancy: Avoid where possible; consider non-pharmacological measures for insomnia in pregnancy
sideEffects: Drowsiness, dizziness, headache, complex sleep behaviours (sleep-walking, sleep-eating), anterograde amnesia, dependence and withdrawal symptoms on abrupt cessation
pharmacokinetics: Rapid onset of action with a short elimination half-life (approximately 2–3 hours)
clinicalPearls: Use lowest effective dose for shortest possible duration (usually ≤4 weeks); counsel patients about avoiding alcohol and activities requiring full alertness the next day
indication: Short-term management of insomnia characterized by difficulty falling asleep
